description: The image displays two pie charts, “All Changes” and “All Errors,” each segmented into six categories represented by distinct colors and labeled with their respective percentages. The “All Changes” chart shows a large light green segment at 50%, followed by a pale yellow segment at 26%, a mustard yellow segment at 14%, a dark green segment at 4%, a blue segment at 5%, and a very thin light blue segment at 1%. The “All Errors” chart features a large light green segment at 56%, a pale yellow segment at 29%, a mustard yellow segment at 6%, a dark green segment at 3%, a blue segment at 5%, and a very thin light blue segment at 1%. A legend on the right correlates each color with a category: light green for “P”, dark green for “PW”, pale yellow for “RW”, light blue for “N”, and blue for “NW”. Both charts include percentage labels directly on or near their corresponding slices, and the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size from the largest to the smallest.
